idea-plugin.name: LaTeX Compile & Preview
idea-plugin.description:
High-performance real-time LaTeX compilation and PDF preview for IntelliJ Platform IDEs.

LaTeX Compile & Preview transforms your IntelliJ IDE into a responsive, distraction-free LaTeX authoring environment with side-by-side code editing, reactive background auto-compilation, and embedded PDF rendering.

✨ Key Features

  • Native Split View: Work seamlessly with LaTeX source code on the left and a live PDF preview on the right.
  • Reactive Auto-Compile: Fast, debounced (600ms) background compilation on typing and saving with per-file mutex locking to prevent concurrent latexmk collisions.
  • Embedded Chromium Preview (JCEF + PDF.js): Modern PDF rendering with strict sequential page loading, eliminating race conditions that previously reordered bibliography or appendix pages.
  • Scroll Synchronization: Proportional scrolling between the LaTeX editor and PDF preview, with an instant toolbar toggle (Sync: ON / OFF).
  • Advanced Zoom & Navigation: Step zoom (25% to 400%), quick 100%/150% toggle, Fit-to-Width mode, mouse-wheel zoom (Ctrl/Cmd + Scroll), and keyboard shortcuts.
  • One-Click PDF Export: Save the compiled PDF to any local directory directly from the preview toolbar using the native file chooser.
  • Reverse Navigation (SyncTeX): Double-click any rendered page in the PDF preview to jump directly to the corresponding source line in the editor.
  • Syntax Highlighting: Fast, deterministic lexer providing syntax coloring for LaTeX commands, environments, inline/display math ($...$, $$...$$), comments, delimiters, and escaped characters.
  • Compiler Error Reporting: Clear error diagnostics extracted directly from latexmk logs displayed in an in-editor overlay panel.

📋 Requirements & Additional Information

  • LaTeX Distribution: Requires a local TeX distribution (TeX Live, MacTeX, or MiKTeX) with latexmk available in the system PATH.
  • Runtime: Requires JetBrains Runtime (JBR) with JCEF enabled (standard in JetBrains IDEs).
  • Supported File Types: .tex, .sty, .cls, .dtx, .ins.
  • Supported IDEs: IntelliJ IDEA (Ultimate & Community), PyCharm, WebStorm, CLion, GoLand, Rider, Android Studio (2024.2 to 2026.x).
  • 🔒 Security & Privacy: 100% local processing. No telemetry, no external network requests, and no document contents sent to third-party services.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Version 2026.1.1.3

  • 💾 PDF Export / Download: Added a dedicated button in the preview toolbar to easily save the compiled PDF to any local disk path via the native system dialog.
  • 🔗 Real-Time Scroll Sync: Integrated real-time scroll synchronization between the LaTeX editor and the PDF preview, with an interactive toolbar toggle (Sync: ON / OFF).
  • 🔍 Enhanced Zoom Controls: Added granular zoom buttons (25% to 400%), quick 100%/150% toggle, Fit-to-Width button, mouse wheel zoom (Ctrl/Cmd + Scroll), and keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl/Cmd + + / - / 0).
  • 📄 Deterministic Sequential Rendering: Fixed race condition where lightweight pages (e.g. references and bibliographies) rendered out-of-order before earlier pages, using strict sequential async/await page processing.
  • 🛡️ Concurrency Safety: Introduced per-file mutex locking combined with a 600ms debounce pipeline to prevent concurrent latexmk build collisions and corrupted auxiliary files.
  • 🎯 Error Diagnostics: Improved compilation error parser to capture and present latexmk failures directly within a dedicated error overlay.
  • 🧪 Automated Test Suite: Added comprehensive unit and regression tests covering lexer tokenization, compiler error extraction, scroll synchronization math, and edge cases.
